Real Mac native window lifecycle, OS notifications, native clipboard/OLE, physical keyboard, screen readers, quit guard and production rollout remain unverified by this run.

Second native close completes with exactly one 4 MiB SHA256-matching file and retained main-window result.

evidence_notes: Original native receipts remain private. Existing app PIDs are omitted; non-app event routing IDs are labelled owning-file-page. No screenshots or account paths are published.

The first candidate probe reached app-scoped cancellation before release but failed a fixture read-audit assertion. Independent review found the fixture could drain buffered SFTP requests after transport closure; the fixture now rejects aborted/inactive reads and requires transport_closed rather than timeout/shutdown. The successful rerun used the identical CI executable; assertions were preserved and strengthened.

Earlier harness development failures (pre-remote source-variable shadowing; first-batch barrier before any destination bytes and attempted hash of a locked staging file) were not product failures. The final fixture pauses after a full 64 x 32 KiB batch, sizes staging via a shared handle and hashes only the completed destination.
No persona score is certified by these narrow checks.

The prelaunch driver checks CI head/repository/workflow, artifact bytes and isolation ancestry. Effective checkout-vs-head equivalence was additionally checked manually for these two runs; the driver does not automate that additional check.
